park.note: national park on the Tatun volcanoes, closest to the city

qixing.note: 1,120 m, highest point of Taipei City

shamao.note: round lava dome on the flank of Qixing (Wikidata Q16926734)

zhugao.note: source of the lava terrace of Qingtiangang (Wikidata Q31622132)

title.en: Grass Mountain, Sulfur and a Guesthouse

tagline.zh-Hant: 從採硫的山，到離城市最近的國家公園
tagline.en: From a sulfur mountain to the national park nearest the city

zh: 臺北盆地北邊的這片山，
以前叫做「草山」。
en: These hills on the northern edge of the Taipei Basin
used to be called Grass Mountain.

zh: 相傳官府為了防人盜採硫磺而放火燒山，
山上只剩草，不長樹。
en: Officials are said to have burned the slopes to deter sulfur thieves,
leaving grass but no trees.

zh: 硫磺在明、清兩代，
就有人開採與買賣。
en: Sulfur was mined and traded here
during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

zh: 十八世紀，漢人開始移入這片山區。
en: In the eighteenth century Han Chinese began to settle these hills.

zh: 十九世紀末，
這一帶出現了溫泉旅館與俱樂部。
en: By the late nineteenth century
hot-spring clubs and resorts had appeared in the area.

zh: 日本在這裡設立大屯國立公園。
en: On 27 December 1937
Japan established Daiton National Park here.

zh: 日治時期，擎天崗被劃為大嶺峠牧場，
用來種茶與放牛。
en: Under Japanese rule Qingtiangang was made the Dalingzhi Ranch,
for growing tea and grazing cattle.

zh: 戰後，政府在擎天崗與冷水坑一帶
設立陽明山牧場。
en: After the war the government set up the Yangmingshan Ranch
around Qingtiangang and Lengshuikeng.

zh: 1950年，為了紀念明代學者王陽明，
「草山」改名「陽明山」。
en: In 1950, in honour of the Ming scholar Wang Yangming,
Grass Mountain was renamed Yangmingshan.

zh: 中山樓，過去是國民大會開會的地方。
en: The Chung-Shan Building was once the meeting place of the National Assembly.

zh: 陽明書屋原名中興賓館，1969到1970年興建，
是蔣中正在臺灣唯一親自選定興建的行館。
en: Yangming Shuwu, first called the Zhongxing Guesthouse, was built in 1969 and 1970,
the only residence in Taiwan whose site Chiang Kai-shek chose himself.

zh: 1962年開始規劃國家公園，
最初的範圍有兩萬八千四百公頃。
en: Planning for a national park began in 1962,
with an initial area of 28,400 hectares.

zh: 1985年9月16日，陽明山國家公園成立，
面積約一萬一千三百公頃。
en: On 16 September 1985 Yangmingshan National Park was established,
covering about 11,300 hectares.

zh: 2020年6月，這裡獲認證為世界第一座「都會寧靜公園」。
en: In June 2020 it was certified as the world's first Urban Quiet Park.

tagline.zh-Hant: 牧場、行館與走得到的火山
tagline.en: A ranch, a guesthouse and volcanoes within walking reach

zh: 陽明山，是距離都會核心最近的國家公園。
en: Yangmingshan is the national park closest to the city's core.

zh: 範圍橫跨臺北市的北投、士林，
和新北市的萬里、金山、三芝、淡水。
en: It spans Beitou and Shilin in Taipei
and Wanli, Jinshan, Sanzhi and Tamsui in New Taipei.

zh: 陽明公園距離市區大約十七公里。
en: Yangming Park is about 17 kilometres from the city centre.

zh: 1950年改名之後，
政府設立陽明山管理局，開闢了這座公園。
en: After the renaming of 1950,
a Yangmingshan administration was set up and laid out this park.

zh: 陽明書屋過去用來接待國內外貴賓，
也是夏天避暑的地方。
en: Yangming Shuwu once received guests from home and abroad
and served as a summer retreat.

zh: 現在它是國家公園的人文史蹟，
也是環境教育的場地。
en: Today it is one of the park's historic sites
and a place for environmental education.

zh: 竹子湖海拔約650到670公尺，
在公園的核心區。
en: Zhuzihu, at about 650 to 670 metres,
lies in the park's core area.

zh: 北有小觀音山、東有七星山、西有大屯山，
往南則敞開，俯瞰臺北盆地。
en: Xiaoguanyin to the north, Qixing to the east, Datun to the west;
southward it opens over the Taipei Basin.

zh: 往東越過七星山，
是擎天崗草原。
en: East across Qixing Mountain
lies the grassland of Qingtiangang.

zh: 擎天崗的牧場後來由臺北市農會經營，
牛隻屬於北投、士林與金山的農民。
en: The ranch at Qingtiangang was later run by the Taipei City Farmers' Association;
the herds belonged to farmers of Beitou, Shilin and Jinshan.

zh: 草原上現在還有牛，
公園提醒遊客要保持安全距離。
en: Cattle still roam the grassland,
and the park asks visitors to keep a safe distance.

zh: 夢幻湖有觀景臺與步道，
路程不長，適合親子健行。
en: Menghuan Pond has a viewing deck and a short trail,
an easy walk for families.

zh: 擎天崗，是公園裡最受歡迎的健行地點。
en: Qingtiangang is the park's most popular hiking destination.

zh: 春有花季、夏有山嵐濃霧，
臺北人的四季，在這座山上分得清楚。
en: Flowers in spring, mist and fog in summer:
on this mountain Taipei's seasons are easy to tell apart.

title.zh-Hant: 芒草、水韭與一年兩百天的雨
title.en: Grassland, Quillwort and Two Hundred Days of Rain

tagline.zh-Hant: 雲霧裡的火山，長著什麼、住著什麼
tagline.en: What grows and lives on volcanoes wrapped in cloud

zh: 陽明山國家公園的海拔，
從兩百公尺到一千一百二十公尺。
en: Yangmingshan National Park
rises from 200 to 1,120 metres above the sea.

zh: 鞍部氣象站的年雨量約四千七百公釐，
一年有兩百零五天下雨。
en: The Anbu weather station records about 4,700 millimetres of rain a year,
falling on 205 days.

zh: 年平均相對濕度將近九成，
全年日照只有九百五十多個小時。
en: Relative humidity averages nearly 90 per cent,
and the sun shines for only some 950 hours a year.

zh: 七星山東南側的夢幻湖，
是國家級重要濕地。
en: Menghuan Pond, on the south-east side of Qixing,
is a wetland of national importance.

zh: 湖裡長著臺灣水韭，
一種只在臺灣才有的水生蕨類。
en: In it grows the Taiwan quillwort,
an aquatic fern found only in Taiwan.

zh: 湖面常因雲霧飄過
而顯得朦朧。
en: Drifting cloud and mist
often veil the water.

zh: 公園裡記錄到1,360種維管束植物。
en: The park has recorded 1,360 species of vascular plants.

zh: 擎天崗是起伏平緩的草原，
草地之間夾著低矮的灌木。
en: Qingtiangang is gently rolling grassland
dotted with low shrubs.

zh: 這裡記錄到168種蝴蝶
與122種鳥。
en: The park lists 168 butterfly species
and 122 kinds of birds.

zh: 在火山噴氣口附近，
火山氣體讓植物無法生長。
en: Close to the volcanic vents,
the gases kill the vegetation.

zh: 園區裡的小油坑，海拔約805公尺，
有噴氣孔與硫磺結晶。
en: Xiaoyoukeng, at about 805 metres,
has fumaroles and sulfur crystals.

zh: 春天是公園的花季，
櫻花是其中一景。
en: Spring is the flower season in the park,
with cherry blossom among its sights.

zh: 這裡的最低溫紀錄，
是零下3.7度。
en: The lowest temperature recorded here
is minus 3.7°C.

zh: 雨、霧與火山的熱，
一起決定了這片山上長什麼。
en: Rain, mist and volcanic heat
together decide what grows on these hills.

tagline.zh-Hant: 大屯火山群：二十多座火山，與還在冒氣的地底
tagline.en: The Tatun group: twenty volcanoes and a ground that still steams

zh: 大屯火山群在臺北市北邊約十五公里，
有二十座左右的火山。
en: The Tatun Volcanic Group lies about 15 kilometres north of Taipei
and has some twenty volcanoes.

zh: 它位在琉球島弧的西端，
是板塊隱沒帶上的火山。
en: It stands at the western end of the Ryukyu Arc,
above a subduction zone.

zh: 火山活動主要發生在280萬到20萬年前；
岩石以安山岩質為主。
en: Most of its eruptions came between 2.8 and 0.2 million years ago;
the rock is mainly andesitic.

zh: 七星山海拔1,120公尺，
是臺北市的最高點。
en: Qixing Mountain, 1,120 metres,
is the highest point of Taipei City.

zh: 它大約七十萬年前開始噴發；
山頂原有火山口，侵蝕後留下七座小峰。
en: It began erupting about 700,000 years ago;
its summit crater has eroded into seven small peaks.

zh: 南側的紗帽山是一座圓形的熔岩穹丘，
看起來像一頂烏紗帽。
en: Shamao Mountain to the south is a round lava dome
shaped like an official's gauze cap.

zh: 紗帽山與七股山，
都是七星山的寄生火山。
en: Shamao and Qigu
are both parasitic volcanoes of Qixing.

zh: 冷水坑曾是火山爆裂口，
泉源附近的岩石因地熱而變成黏土。
en: Lengshuikeng was once an explosion crater;
near its springs, heat has turned the rock to clay.

zh: 擎天崗，是竹篙山熔岩形成的階地。
en: Qingtiangang is a terrace formed by lava from Zhugao Mountain.

zh: 竹子湖原本是三十五萬年前火山噴發造成的堰塞湖，
後來缺口被侵蝕，湖水流光。
en: Zhuzihu was a lake dammed by an eruption 350,000 years ago;
erosion breached it and the water drained away.

zh: 大屯山，是火山群裡第三大的山體。
en: Datun Mountain is the third largest edifice in the group.

zh: 2019到2022年的觀測顯示，
地底的岩漿熱液系統仍在釋放氣體。
en: Observations from 2019 to 2022 show
a magmatic-hydrothermal system still degassing below.

zh: 研究認為，七星山、大油坑與磺嘴山，
是未來可能噴發的地點。
en: Studies name Qixing, Dayoukeng and Huangzui
as the places where a future eruption could occur.

zh: 中央研究院在公園裡設有大屯火山觀測站，
持續監測這些火山。
en: Academia Sinica keeps the Tatun volcano observatory in the park
to monitor these volcanoes.
